caveats: Google Maps was reachable but served a 'limited view': ratings were visible for most businesses while exact review counts often were not. Counts in this file come from a directory citation where noted and are labelled.
Google web search itself returned a bot check from this machine, so listing data came from Maps panels and third-party directories; some directory figures may lag the live profile.
Appleby's website announces a move to 8 Old Bridge Turnpike Suite 4 (October 2023) while Google still lists 43 Main St; batch.json also carries 43 Main St. Treat the Google address as possibly stale.

Jaqui-Kuhn's site sits behind a Cloudflare block that a real Chrome session could not pass, so its layout, CTAs and forms could not be verified; its Google profile shows 40 Cedar Ave while the batch and site show 17 S Adelaide Ave - inference: two entrances/addresses for one facility.

Highland Park Lock & Locksmith publishes no street address and no Google Business Profile was located; inference: it may be a mobile-only operation or a lead-generation site rather than an owner-verified shop. Identity should be confirmed by phone before any outreach.

Above and Beyond Child Care operates inside the Highland Park Conservative Temple building with a Jewish-values curriculum (inference: affiliated or sponsored by the congregation) but is a licensed child care business, so it was triaged as a business rather than a place of worship; the state licence page (childcarenj.gov) returned HTTP 403 so licence details come from a search summary.

Greenhouse Loft is live only on a Squarespace account subdomain; the domain its own structured data declares (greenhouselofthp.com) redirects to an unrelated gambling site as observed on 2026-11-12/13 - either the domain lapsed and was repurposed, or was never properly connected. Verify with the owner before proposing domain recovery.
